set.body: Parent AC4-5. Extend existing prepared measures with best fixed-width window, shortest connected requested-quantity window, disconnected sets at declared grid resolution and sparse grid/crop/rebin. Retain exact axis/occurrence/conditioning/policy/candidate coverage and unavailable/external ledgers, deterministic ties and separate atoms. Unsupported support-only concentration stays unavailable. Rebin complete measure or partition, never cropped top-k. Separate run-level clock uncertainty; joint/path queries require joint evidence or explicit approximation. ADR0019 contract choices and rejected alternatives. Independent Fraction oracle: 1/2 on [0,2) union [8,10),1/4 point4,1/8 unavailable,1/8 external. Region[0,1): allocated1/8,bounds[0,1/2]; allocatable3/4 so request0.9 unattainable. Broad/narrow/multimodal courts, compiled mutants and exact review/scoped gates.
